papers.title: CurvDelta: Low-Curvature Delta Modeling For Surgical Learning and Unlearning
papers.desc: A central challenge in adapting large language models (LLMs) is capability preservation: an adaptation can achieve its target while degrading general capabilities.

papers.title: LightTAR: Light and Fast Target-Aware Representations for Multimodal Tabular Learning
papers.desc: Multimodal tabular learning involves classification and regression on tables combining structured numerical and categorical features with unstructured text and images.

papers.title: StrideWorld: Benchmarking Scene Rigidity and Action Consistency in Interactive Video World Model
papers.desc: Interactive video world models turn user commands into the exploration of a generated scene, which requires the scene to keep its 3D structure as the camera moves and each action to keep a stable effect.

papers.title: BLIP-Live: Balancing Timeliness & Firing Precision in Proactive Streaming Video Agents
papers.desc: Streaming video understanding is becoming increasingly important for real-world interactive systems.

papers.title: StatePortal: Agentic Checkpoint Synthesis for Testing Deep States in Interactive Software
papers.desc: Large language models have reduced the effort to generate code for interactive software with graphical user interfaces (GUIs).

papers.title: WaveView: The Novel View Is in the Noise
papers.desc: Generative novel view synthesis (NVS) employs a diffusion model to render a static or dynamic scene from a target camera view.

papers.title: Thinking Fast, Anywhere: One System-1 for the Decision Points of Any Agent Workflow
papers.desc: Autonomous LLM agents incur substantial cost and latency by invoking a large model (System-2) at every step, even when many intermediate actions choose among a small set of known candidates.

papers.title: Chorus: Shared N-gram Embeddings with Layer-wise Adaptation
papers.desc: Language models can gain capacity at little computational cost from n-gram embedding tables: large tables of learned vectors for short sequences of consecutive tokens, which are looked up and added to the model's input or to its intermediate layers.

papers.title: TabBioMed: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Biomedical Tabular Learning
papers.desc: Recent advances in machine learning have accelerated biomedical prediction, but evaluation on structured biomedical data remains fragmented, especially for datasets with high dimensionality, large sample size, missingness, and class imbalance.

papers.title: RICoT: Recurrent Interleaved Chain-of-Thought for Page Stream Segmentation
papers.desc: Large language models (LLMs) have renewed interest in Page Stream Segmentation (PSS), splitting a multi-page file into its constituent documents.

papers.title: Kezek: Splitting Mono Two-Person Conversations into Per-Speaker Tracks for Full-Duplex Dialogue Data
papers.desc: Full-duplex spoken dialogue models learn turn-taking, overlaps and backchannels from conversations recorded with one channel per speaker, but most available conversational audio is a single mono mix.

papers.title: BiCAT: Bimanual Coordination Action Tokenization
papers.desc: Autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) models predict discrete action tokens with the next-token objective of their vision-language backbone, so the action tokenizer defines the interface between the policy and the robot.

papers.title: Choosing Quantized Code LLMs by File Size and Energy per Solved Task
papers.desc: A developer running a code assistant on a laptop downloads one model file, and local inference moves the energy of every request onto that machine.

papers.title: AVTR: Adaptive Multimodal Reasoning with Visual Imagination
papers.desc: Vision-Language Models increasingly rely on textual reasoning to solve advanced multimodal tasks.

papers.title: PGPO: Prototype-Guided Progressive Obfuscation for Privacy-Preserving LLM-Enhanced Recommendation
papers.desc: LLM-enhanced recommender systems encode item side information into semantic embeddings, but these embeddings may leak sensitive textual attributes through inversion attacks.
